question: Who was the viceroy of India when Arya Samaj was founded by Swami Dayananda Saraswati?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Northbrook.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Northbrook was the viceroy of India when Arya Samaj was founded by Swami Dayananda Saraswati.**
 
• Lord Northbrook was appointed as viceroy of India from **1872 to 1876.**
 
• **"Arya Samaj":**
 
 
• This reform was one of the best movements for modern Hinduism.
 
• It was founded by **Dayananda Saraswati in 1875 AD**.
 
• Whose main purpose of **"Re-establishing the Vedas"**.
 
• Dayananda Saraswati gave the slogan** "Back to Vedas".**
 
• Dayananda Saraswati criticized evil practices like idolatry, caste system, untouchability, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Curzon:**

 
 
• He was appointed as the Viceroy of India in the year 1899 and his Viceroyship ended in the year 1905.
 
• He became the Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs in 1919.
 
• MacDonnell Commission was appointed by Lord Curzon in 1901 and it submitted its report in the same year.
 
• Lord Curzon set up a Police Commission under Sir Andrew Frazer in 1902-03.
 
 
 
• **Lord Lansdowne (1888-1893):**
 
 
• During the term of Lord Lansdowne (1888-1893), Indian Council Act was passed in 1892.
 
• The significance of the Indian Council Act is to enlarge the Membership of central legislative councils.
 
• It transformed the viceroy's Executive Council into a miniature cabinet on the portfolio system.
 
 
 
• **Lord Dalhousie:**
 
 
• From 1848 to 1856, he was the Governor-General of India.
 
• His main intention was the expansion of British rule in India.
 
• The Doctrine of Lapse was introduced by him in India and he annexed eight states during his period.
 
• The Second Anglo Sikh was fought during his period and the whole of Punjab was brought under the British empire by him.
